# Clear captured log history

<small>Source: [`R/utils.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/utils.R) · Help: `?ht_clear_log_history`</small>

Removes all stored log entries accumulated via [`ht_enable_log_capture()`](ht_enable_log_capture.md).

## Usage

```r
ht_clear_log_history()
```

## Value

Invisibly returns `NULL`.

## Deprecated

Deprecated since 0.14.0; see [`ht_enable_log_capture()`](ht_enable_log_capture.md). It still works and
warns.
